text:
It's similar to another post from yesterday. 
Waiting times are normal for meeting dates, online application processing, interview scheduling etc. Waiting time is NOT normal for decisions. 
A decision after an interview should not take more than a couple of weeks, tops. That's only if the clerk cannot decide on their own and they want to consult someone else. 

Waiting one month for a decision, when literally nothing is changing, and they are not waiting for anything, is not normal.
You need to discover what is the holdup. Unless they are waiting for an external opinion (like Israeli police check or something like this), this is not normal and not ok.
